title: Frozen + unseen/adversarial extraction comparison

Batch 04 may create locked fixtures, labels, manifests, reports, and audit artifacts; it must not modify extraction semantics, provider prompts/configuration, canonical persistence, or runtime authority. Measure role and candidate quality, provenance integrity, structural/enrichment coverage, rejection causality, run-to-run stability, latency, and cost. Record evidence only; Batch 05 alone selects an architecture.
